headline: Ukrainian drone strikes knock out Yandex data centers, including AI supercomputers
summary: Ukrainian drones struck Yandex data centers, including one housing supercomputers used for AI training. Yandex later confirmed drone attacks damaged three data centers, forcing it to shut down two facilities and partially disable a third; one report says the affected cloud region might not return to operation.
